title: Senior Unity Developer
job_description:
Senior Unity Developer

(WebGL, WebGPU, AR & Cross-Platform)




About the Role

Idea Comindo is seeking an experienced and highly creative Senior Unity Developer to join our team. In this role, your primary focus will be on the presentation layer-acting as the bridge between our robust NestJS backend and the end-user. You will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing interactive frontend applications and games across multiple platforms (WebGL, WebGPU, Desktop, Mobile, and AR).

The ideal candidate is a frontend specialist who writes clean C# code and Unity Game Engine expert, excels at consuming backend data (REST/GraphQL), understands deep performance optimization, and thrives in a results-driven environment.


Key Responsibilities

• Frontend Data Integration: Connect the Unity client to our NestJS backend via REST APIs and GraphQL, ensuring seamless asynchronous data flow and real-time state updates without blocking the main thread.

• Geospatial Visualization: Translate raw geospatial coordinates and map data provided by the backend into accurate, performant 3D visual representations within the Unity environment, managing floating-point rendering challenges.

• AI State Rendering: Consume AI-driven responses from the backend to trigger dynamic visual states, UI updates, and character behaviors in real-time.

• Artwork & Animation Implementation: Integrate 3D models, textures, and UI elements. Utilize Unity's Animator, Timeline, and visual effects tools to create polished, fluid frontend experiences optimized for web and mobile.

• Cross-Platform Build & Optimization: Profile and optimize applications to ensure maximum performance, focusing on reducing draw calls, managing memory, and optimizing assets specifically for WebGL, WebGPU, and Mobile browsers.


Technical Requirements

• Core Engine: High proficiency in Unity/Unity3D and robust knowledge of C# programming.

• Platform Expertise: Proven experience building for WebGL, WebGPU, and Desktop (Windows/MacOS). Familiarity with HTML5, JavaScript, and web browser performance optimization is essential.

• AR Development: Hands-on experience with AR frameworks such as ARKit, ARCore, and Vuforia. Solid understanding of both marker-based and marker-less tracking.

• API & Data: Strong practical experience consuming REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints within Unity, including handling JSON/data serialization for frontend rendering.

• Art Pipeline: Solid understanding of the 3D art pipeline (importing FBX/OBJ, materials, shaders, lighting, rigging) and optimizing those assets for constrained platforms.

• Version Control: Proficient in using Git and standard version control workflows.


Experience & Educational Background

• Experience: Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in Unity development, with a proven portfolio of published WebGL, WebGPU, Desktop, and/or AR projects.

• Education: D3 or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.




Soft Skills

• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to designers and backend developers.

• Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Creativity: A keen eye for detail, strong visual sense, and an innovative approach to interactive experiences.

Comfortable working with PostgreSQL (basic querying, indexing awareness, understanding of Odoo schema).

Familiarity with Git and standard SDLC practices (branching, merge requests, code review, tagging).

Proven track record of troubleshooting production issues in Odoo (performance, deadlocks, broken flows) and delivering stable fixes.

Able to communicate clearly in Bahasa Indonesia and working English; able to explain technical topics in simple terms to non‑ technical colleagues.

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer who is equally passionate about  building polished, user-friendly interfaces and designing robust, scalable backend 
systems. You will own features end-to-end—from the pixel-perfect frontend in  Next.js/React to the domain-driven microservices in the backend.

- Scalability & Reliability: Implement event-driven workflows (Kafka/RabbitMQ), optimize for high-traffic peaks, and ensure system idempotency and failure handling.

- Backend Stack: Proficient in Node.js, TypeScript, or Go. Strong experience with NestJS or similar frameworks is a plus. 
- Architecture: Solid understanding of Microservices, BFF, and Distributed Systems concepts. 
- Database & Messaging: Hands-on experience with Relational Databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), Caching (Redis), and Message Brokers  (Kafka/RabbitMQ/PubSub). 
- Tools: Mastery of Version Control (Git) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines. 
- Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication in English (both written and spoken).

Nice to Have Experiences

Job Description :
Project definition & sprint planning:

–   Work closely with the IT Manager to understand each project's goals, user needs, and business constraints

–   Translate product vision into concrete, scoped sprint tasks with clear acceptance criteria

–   Anticipate technical dependencies and sequencing issues before the sprint starts

–   Contribute to technical decision-making — propose the right approach, flag trade-offs, escalate when needed

Team management & daily operations:

–   Directly manage the development team: assign tasks, track progress, and ensure deadlines are met

–   Be the first point of contact when a developer is blocked — solve it, find the answer, or escalate fast

–   Facilitate communication between developers so no one is working in isolation or duplicating effort

–   Manage Git versioning and branch strategy — merges, naming conventions, release preparation — to give every team member full clarity on what is in production and what is in progress

Reporting & visibility:

–   Report progress, blockers, and risks to the IT Manager on a regular cadence

–   Maintain a clear and up-to-date view of every active project across all Balimmo products

–   Identify patterns — recurring bugs, recurring blockers, recurring misunderstandings — and address the root cause

Emergency & tooling:

–   Step in to code features or fix bugs when the situation demands it — you are not just a coordinator

–   Build internal tools or scripts that improve team productivity and project management when needed

Requirement :
Experience & background:

–   3–5+ years of experience in a technical role that combined development and project coordination

–   You have managed or closely coordinated a team of developers — you know how to keep people moving without micromanaging

–   You have worked on multi-product or multi-project environments before — juggling priorities is not new to you

–   Solid understanding of software development cycles, sprint methodology, and Git workflows

Technical depth:

–   You can read and understand code across our stack — Next.js, Laravel, React Native, Flutter — even if you are not an expert in all of them

–   You can code when needed: fix a bug, build a small tool, review a pull request with real feedback

–   You understand architecture decisions well enough to ask the right questions and spot risks early

–   Hands-on experience with Git: branching strategies, merge management, conflict resolution

title: Odoo Developer
job_description:
Role Summary

We are looking for an Odoo Developer to take technical ownership of our Odoo ERP platform (ticketing, RFID, POS, Finance, Retail, F&B, Sales & Marketing). You will work side‑by‑side with the Odoo Functional/Business Analyst and our external vendor to build, fix, and improve custom Odoo modules, integrations, and reports that are critical to day‑to‑day park operations.

This is a hands‑on coding role: you will read and write Odoo modules, debug production issues, and implement changes in a controlled, test‑driven way.




Key Responsibilities

Develop and customize Odoo modules (Python, XML, JS/QWeb) based on agreed functional specs (POS, Ticketing, RFID, Finance, Inventory, F&B, Marketing).

Maintain and refactor existing custom code delivered by the vendor to improve stability, readability, and performance.

Implement small to medium change requests (new fields, workflows, wizards, reports, dashboards) without over‑customizing core Odoo.




Bug Fixing & Production Support

Investigate and fix urgent bugs in WB’s custom Odoo code (including POS, ticket validation, refund logic, settlement flows).

Work with the Functional/Business Analyst to reproduce issues, isolate root causes (config vs data vs code), and provide clear technical explanations.

Implement hotfixes safely (using staging and rollback plans) and document all changes.




Integrations & Technical Troubleshooting

Build and maintain integrations between Odoo and external systems (OTAs, payment gateways/EDC, RFID/gate systems, e‑commerce, marketing tools).

Troubleshoot API failures, timeouts, and data sync issues; add monitoring and logging where needed.

Work with the technical lead on performance tuning (workers, caching, SQL queries) and environment-level issues.




Technical Design, Code Quality, & Documentation

Design solutions that respect Odoo architecture and keep a clean separation between custom modules and standard code.

Follow best practices for version control (Git), branching, code reviews, and deployment pipelines.

Produce and maintain technical documentation for custom modules, data models, and integrations.


Testing & Release Management

Write and maintain unit tests / basic automated tests where feasible; at a minimum, ensure robust manual test scripts for critical flows.

Support UAT: prepare test data, fix defects, and iterate quickly based on feedback from key users.

Participate in planning and executing releases (staging, smoke tests, rollback procedures).


Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Work closely with the Odoo Functional/Business Analyst to understand business requirements and constraints.

Coordinate with the external vendor on bigger changes, upgrades, and complex incidents, using your technical analysis to push for precise fixes.

Proactively suggest technical improvements that reduce downtime, simplify maintenance, and improve data quality.


Qualification:

3+ years of hands‑on experience as an Odoo Developer (or strong Python developer with at least 2 years focused on Odoo).

Solid experience building and customizing Odoo modules in Python (models, business logic) and XML/QWeb (views, reports).

Strong understanding of Odoo framework: ORM, security (record rules/access rights), workflows, scheduled actions, and multi‑company/multi‑currency concepts.

Experience integrating Odoo with external systems via REST APIs (JSON/XML), webhooks, or middleware.

Comfortable working with PostgreSQL (basic querying, indexing awareness, understanding of Odoo schema).

Familiarity with Git and standard SDLC practices (branching, merge requests, code review, tagging).

Proven track record of troubleshooting production issues in Odoo (performance, deadlocks, broken flows) and delivering stable fixes.

Able to communicate clearly in Bahasa Indonesia and working English; able to explain technical topics in simple terms to non‑technical colleagues.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
job_description:
Apply at https://forms.gle/ydWzZ9ztnzG4f9Yo9

About Bukumed

Bukumed is a healthcare SaaS platform digitising the operations of medical facilities across Indonesia — from primary clinics and pharmacies to independent practices. We are not just software. We are building Indonesia's digital health infrastructure, integrated with SatuSehat, BPJS, and international FHIR standards.

Our product is used every day by doctors, pharmacists, and clinic staff. That means: every line of code you write has a real impact on patient care quality.

We are growing fast. We are now looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who does not just know how to build interfaces — but knows how to leverage AI to move faster and think smarter.

The Role

You will be the full owner of the frontend experience at Bukumed. Not a spec executor — but a technical partner who shapes how the product feels and works for non-technical users in clinical environments.

You will work across modules: EMR, pharmacy management, billing, patient queuing, and SatuSehat integration. All real-time. All high-stakes.

What You Will Do

Product & Interface

Build UIs that are intuitive for clinic staff — including nurses, pharmacists, and admins who are not tech-savvy

Translate complex clinical workflows into simple, efficient user flows

Build and maintain the Bulan Design System (MUI + Figma-based) to keep the product consistent across all modules

AI-Augmented Engineering

Use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of your daily workflow — not a novelty

Build UI components for AI-powered features such as streaming inputs, diagnosis suggestions, and document automation

Evaluate and validate AI-generated code before it reaches production

Quality & Collaboration

Lead code reviews focused on quality, not just syntax

Collaborate directly with product, UX writing, and backend engineering (Go + PostgreSQL)

Ensure performance, accessibility, and compliance with Indonesian health data regulations (PMK, SatuSehat)

What We Are Looking For

Technical (Required)

5+ years building production-grade frontend applications

Strong React + TypeScript — hooks, state management, performance optimisation

Solid grasp of modern frontend architecture: component design patterns, code splitting, rendering strategies

Experience with REST APIs and real-time integrations (WebSocket or SSE)

Comfortable with testing: React Testing Library, Playwright, or Cypress

AI Literacy (Required)

Actively using AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow right now

Able to write effective prompts that produce accurate components and logic

Know when to trust AI output and when to write it yourself

Good to Have

Experience building UI for multi-role B2B SaaS products

Familiar with MUI, Figma-to-code workflows, or design systems

Prior experience in healthcare tech or with sensitive data environments

Experience with Next.js or other SSR frameworks

What We Are Not Looking For

Engineers who wait for perfect specs before moving

Developers who see AI coding tools as a threat rather than a tool

People who are comfortable staying only in their existing "safe zone" of technology

Our Stack

Frontend : React · TypeScript · MUI · Vite · Next.js Backend : Go · PostgreSQL · Redis Integrations : SatuSehat (FHIR) · BPJS · HL7 Infrastructure: AWS · Docker · GitHub Actions AI Tools : Claude Code · Cursor · GitHub Copilot

Interview Process

We respect your time. The process is short and relevant:

Take Home Assessment (60 min max, async) — we review code or a project you have built; no LeetCode

Phone Interview (30 min) — get to know each other; you share your experience and how you work

System Design & Live Coding (60 min) — frontend architecture discussion + one real React scenario

Culture & Team Fit — Virtual meet the product and engineering team

We will ask how you use AI in your workflow — not as a trick question, but because it is how we actually work.

What We Offer

Remote-first with full flexibility (WIB timezone overlap required)

Competitive compensation + equity as an early team member

Direct access to product decisions — your voice matters

A fast-moving environment that does not sacrifice quality

The chance to build a product used daily by Indonesian healthcare workers

Citizenship Requirement

This role is open to Indonesian citizens only. We are building a product deeply rooted in Indonesia's healthcare system — SatuSehat, BPJS, PMK regulations, and the day-to-day realities of Indonesian clinic operations. We need someone who understands this context from the inside.

How to Apply

Submit here https://forms.gle/ydWzZ9ztnzG4f9Yo9

Bukumed believes that good technology starts with engineers who care. If you want work that makes a real difference — this is it.

Our mission is to guide financial inclusion and empower underbanked partners across the region. We design and operate critical platform components such as the Loan Management System, Repayments Engine, and Product Flow Orchestrator—powering seamless and reliable lending experiences at scale. Our work involves building large-scale distributed systems that impact millions of users, with a emphasis on reliability and scalability. Core engineering principles like idempotency, CAP theorem, and distributed agreement meaningfully contribute to how we architect and evolve our systems. At our core, we are driven by impact—creating financial solutions that make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

You will design, build, and operate backend services that power end‑to‑end lending journeys – from origination and decisioning to servicing and repayments – across multiple markets.

You will work closely with product managers, designers, data and Ops teams to deliver high‑quality features, drive operational excellence, and mentor other engineers. This role is based in Indonesia with close collaboration across distributed teams in Asia.

Design and implement backend services that are robust, scalable, observable, and cost‑efficient, primarily in Golang and running on our Kubernetes‑based platform.
Own end‑to‑end delivery of features and projects: requirements clarification, design, implementation, testing, rollout, and post‑launch monitoring.

Drive operational excellence: instrument services with metrics, logs and traces; define SLIs/SLOs; improve alerting; perform capacity planning and performance tuning; and handle production incidents during on‑call rotations.

Support hiring by participating in interviews and helping improve our question banks, guidelines, and job descriptions.

5+ years of backend engineering experience in a distributed systems environment, with experience with shipping and operating production services at scale.

CSG is a multinational organisation headquartered in the United States with more than 5000 employees in countries around the world.

We believe that by channelling the power of all, we make ordinary customer and employee experiences extraordinary. This is your opportunity to join one of our high-performing teams. Channel the power of YOU and begin the journey to becoming a CSGer.




Our product & team

This role sits within the team that designs and develops capabilities specifically for the Banking and Financial Services vertical using CSG Quote & Order, our cutting-edge CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) and order management platform. Built using the latest technology, our platform modernizes industries like telecommunications and banking.

Our team promotes a collaborative culture where everyone’s contributions are valued, and diversity is celebrated. We prioritize continuous learning and improvement to keep our product competitive, and ensure CSG remains an exciting workplace.

Due to growing demand from high-profile Banking and Financial Services customers, our team is expanding in 2026 and that's where you come in!




About our technology

Our product frontend is built using the Angular framework and web component technology. We are currently moving towards a micro-frontend architecture and would love to have you on board for the journey!

Our backend is super modern adopting a microservice architecture for scalability and flexibility, using Kafka for event streaming and PostgreSQL for data storage.

We use Kubernetes to orchestrate our containers, allowing us to offer cloud (AWS & Azure) and on-premise deployment options of our platform. Our infrastructure is maintained by a state-of-the-art gitops/IaC pipeline.

We heavily lean on open-source tools and libraries, as well as maintaining our own, to make development faster, simpler, and more consistent. Our code is managed using Git, undergoes peer review before we test, package and deploy through our CI/CD pipelines.




About the role

Joining our team as a Frontend Software Engineer, you will collaborate with our cross-functional team to build features/technology for the CSG Quote & Order product.

In your first 90 days, you’ll get comfortable with our system, join a squad, build strong relationships with the team, and get started building cool new features that our customers love.




What you'll do

Build out frontend features using Angular, Web Components and REST API technology.

Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

Participate in code reviews and mentoring of junior developers.

Work with your squad to deliver awesome new features on time and continuously improve.

Experience in contemporary JavaScript frameworks (i.e: Angular or React, Vue, Svelte, Nodejs)

The ability to communicate well, and work in a collaborative team environment

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology related field, or equivalent experience.




Perks & benefits

Work from anywhere: CSG has a global policy called "Flexibility First" that allows employees to work from wherever they feel most productive. The Quote & Order team does not maintain a dedicated office space, so your position will be 100% remote with the exception of several in-person workshops during the year (in Bali – see below – and Melbourne).

Twice-yearly workshops in Bali: Twice a year the whole Quote & Order team gets together in Bali, Indonesia for dedicated in-person time including team presentations, hackathon sessions, training and team-building activities.

title: IT Website & Digital Systems Lead

Position Overview:

The IT Website & Digital Systems Officer is responsible for managing, developing, optimizing, and ensuring the security and performance of the firm’s website, landing pages, tracking systems, digital forms, and automation tools used by Murzal & Partners. This position also plays an important role in supporting digital marketing needs, technical SEO, campaign support, regular website maintenance, as well as the management of internal digital work platforms to ensure that all of the firm’s digital assets operate effectively, efficiently, securely, and professionally.




Main Responsibilities:

1. Website Development & Maintenance

Manage the development, improvement, and updating of the firm’s website.

Create and develop landing pages for campaign and marketing purposes.

Perform regular website maintenance, including troubleshooting and bug fixing.

Manage and ensure proper setup of domains and hosting.

Ensure that the website remains stable, responsive, user-friendly, and professionally maintained.

2. WordPress, Plugin, & Performance Optimization

Conduct audits of active plugins from both security and performance perspectives.

Remove, replace, or adjust inefficient plugins.

Optimize cache plugins and overall website performance.

Implement defer and delay strategies for non-critical JavaScript.

Optimize render-blocking CSS.

Maintain optimal website loading speed across both desktop and mobile platforms.

3. Image Optimization

Optimize website images into more efficient formats such as WebP.

Compress images based on website needs, particularly for hero images, banners, and key pages.

Resize images in accordance with layout requirements.

Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images.

Ensure that website visuals remain high quality without compromising page performance.

4. Tracking & Analytics

Set up and manage tracking tools such as Google Analytics, Meta/Facebook Pixel, and similar platforms.

Implement tag management systems such as Google Tag Manager.

Set up conversion tracking, including form submissions and other key user actions.

Ensure that all tracking data is accurate and reliable for monitoring and campaign evaluation purposes.

5. Technical SEO

Optimize the website structure from a technical SEO perspective, including URLs, sitemap, robots.txt, and indexing.

Identify and resolve technical SEO issues, such as crawl errors and indexing problems.

Ensure strong mobile responsiveness across the website.

Coordinate with the marketing team to support improvements in organic SEO performance.

6. Security & Data Protection

Ensure website security through the management of SSL, firewall protection, and other necessary security measures.

Safeguard and protect user, lead, and customer data collected through the website.

Conduct regular website and digital system backups.

Minimize risks relating to system disruption, data leakage, or technical failure.

7. Form & Lead Management

Create and manage digital forms, including contact forms, lead forms, and campaign-related forms.

Integrate forms with databases or reporting tools such as Google Sheets or other relevant systems.

Set up automated email responses following form submissions.

Ensure proper validation, recording, and storage of lead data.

8. Automation & Tools

Set up marketing automation tools based on campaign or operational needs.

Build automated notification systems via email, WhatsApp, or other relevant platforms where necessary.

Develop workflow automation across tools to improve efficiency.

Provide recommendations on tools or digital systems that may support the firm’s operations.

9. Google Workspace & Microsoft Teams Administration

Understand and manage the use of Google Workspace for the firm’s operational needs, including email, Google Drive, Google Meet, Google Calendar, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.

Understand and manage Microsoft Teams for internal communication, coordination, meetings, and collaboration.

Provide technical support to internal teams regarding the use of Google Workspace and Microsoft Teams.

Assist with account setup, access control, permissions, and troubleshooting related to internal digital work platforms.

Ensure that internal collaboration platforms are used effectively, securely, and in support of team productivity.

10. Campaign & Digital Support

Support the deployment and technical implementation of digital campaigns, including banners, pop-ups, and tracking URLs.

Prepare URL tracking structures, including UTM parameters.

Assist in troubleshooting errors related to digital campaigns or landing pages.

Work closely with the marketing team to ensure campaigns run effectively from a technical perspective.

11. Reporting & Deliverables

Prepare before-and-after performance reports for website optimization work.

Monitor and report improvements in website performance, including loading speed, stability, and tracking effectiveness.

Support efforts to make the website more SEO-friendly and more effective for digital advertising purposes.

Provide bug-fixing support during the post-optimization monitoring and maintenance period.




Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

Proven experience in website management, particularly WordPress.

Strong understanding of plugin management, website performance optimization, and technical SEO.

Proficiency in Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and other relevant tracking tools.

Understanding of website security, backup systems, and data protection principles.

Ability to create and manage landing pages, form integrations, and workflow automation.

Good understanding of Google Workspace and Microsoft Teams administration.

Strong analytical skills in evaluating website and campaign performance.

Detail-oriented, responsive, capable of troubleshooting, and able to work under targets and deadlines.

Familiarity with UI/UX basics, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and marketing tool integrations will be considered an advantage.




Expected Work Output:

The firm’s website operates quickly, securely, stably, and is properly maintained.

Campaign landing pages are effectively created and deployed.

Tracking and analytics systems function accurately.

The website is better optimized for SEO and digital marketing purposes.

Form systems, lead capture, and automation processes are organized and efficient.

Internal digital collaboration platforms function properly and support team coordination.

Regular reports on website performance and improvements are available.

Job Description


About SMS Perkasa

We're an innovative steel and building materials distributor based in Surabaya, transforming how the industry operates through technology. While others in the steel trade rely on spreadsheets and phone calls, we build software that gives us — and our customers — a real edge. 🏗️

The Role

You won't just write code here. You'll steer AI agents that write code, then make sure it's actually good. We use AI coding tools daily — not as novelties, but as core parts of how we ship software. Your job is to define the problem clearly, direct AI to build the solution, review every line it produces, and own what goes to production. 🤖

If that sounds like managing a small engineering team rather than being a solo coder — you're getting the idea. 🎯

What You'll Do

Break down business problems into clear specs and architectural prompts that guide AI agents toward correct solutions
Direct AI coding tools to generate, test, and iterate on code across our systems — from internal platforms to customer-facing products
Design system architecture — APIs, databases, integrations — and make decisions that hold up as we scale
Own features end-to-end: from understanding the business need, through implementation, to production deployment
Write tests that keep AI agents (and yourself) honest. Strong test coverage is how you move fast without breaking things
Collaborate directly with our team to translate real operational challenges in the steel industry into working software

What We Offer

We're a young team that builds things that matter — tools that impact how steel and building materials move across Indonesia. You'll have real freedom to explore ideas and make your own decisions. No one here is going to micromanage you. 💡

Come with your bright ideas. Speak up. Challenge assumptions. That's how we work. 🗣️

We invest seriously in learning — new tools, new skills, personal growth. You'll never stop getting better here. And you'll be part of a team that genuinely values your contributions and has fun doing the work. 📚

We offer competitive compensation and benefits, because that's what good people deserve. ⚖️

Solid engineering fundamentals — You know what good code looks like. Data structures, design patterns, debugging. You need this to catch what AI gets wrong

Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Background in ERP systems, supply chain, or logistics software
Experience building internal tools or B2B products
Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio we can look at

title: DevOps engineers
job_description:
Job Description

Development and maintain the infrastructure: DevOps engineers are responsible for creating and managing the infrastructure needed to support software development and deployment. This includes designing, configuring, and maintaining servers, networks, storage, and other infrastructure components.
Automate processes: DevOps engineers use automation tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef to automate tasks like software deployment, configuration management, and testing. They also develop and maintain scripts and code to automate processes and tasks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams: DevOps engineers work closely with development, testing and support team to ensure that software applications are developed and deployed smoothly. Implement and manage security policies: DevOps engineers are responsible for implementing and managing security policies and procedures to ensure the safety and integrity of the software applications and data. This include identifying potential security threats, implementing security measures, and monitoring for security breaches.
Continuously improve processes: DevOps engineers are always looking for ways to improve the software development and deployment process. They analyze performance metrics and other data to identify areas for improvement and work to implement changes that increase efficiency and reduce errors.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related fields, or equivalent professional experience
Minimum 2 years’ experience with IT operations and infrastructure management and familiar with network and server administration, virtualization, cloud computing, and storage management.
Have a strong foundation and familiarity with operating systems like Linux or Windows.
